Remove it as soon as typescript-eslint accepts a fixed minimatch.

exceptions.rationale: Potential denial of service through glob pattern amplification (globparts). No pattern comes from a user or a page, and neither package reaches the deployed application. Only minimatch 11.0.1 and later fix it, a major version neither @oclif/core (^10.2.5) nor readdir-glob (^10.2.2) accepts, and Bun has no nested override. Remove it as soon as browse accepts a fixed minimatch.
